name: SiMa.ai MLSoC Modalix Product Page
notes: Official SiMa.ai product page for MLSoC / Modalix family. Specifies 50 TOPS multimodal AI compute supporting INT8, BF16, and INT16 precisions at sub-10W power envelope. Available as pin-compatible SoM (compatible with NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX/Nano) and HHHL PCIe Gen5 x8 card. External DRAM capacity and bandwidth are not detailed on this page.
